hero.title: Grok AI: what it is, how it works, and how to start using it
hero.intro: Grok started as X's built-in chatbot — a novelty with a sarcastic streak. It has since grown into a standalone AI platform with real-time web search, video generation, and reasoning capabilities that compete directly with GPT-5.2 and Claude. And you can try it without an X account.

sections.title: What is Grok AI?
sections.body:
Grok is the AI assistant built by [xAI](https://x.ai), the company Elon Musk founded in March 2023. The current flagship model is **Grok 4.1**, released in November 2025, which holds the #1 position on [LMArena's Text Arena](https://lmarena.ai) with an [Elo](/ai-tools/glossary#elo-rating) score of 1483 in thinking mode.

What sets Grok apart from ChatGPT and Claude is its **dual data pipeline**: it searches both real-time X posts and the open web simultaneously. Grok can pull fresh social commentary, trending topics, and breaking news alongside traditional web sources — something no other major chatbot offers natively.

Grok no longer functions as a chatbot tacked onto a social media platform. It runs as a standalone product at [grok.com](https://grok.com) with dedicated mobile apps, a developer API, and enterprise-grade subscription tiers. If you still think of Grok as the "joke chatbot" from 2023, the current generation — trained on xAI's Colossus supercluster with over 200,000 Nvidia GPUs — is a different product entirely.

sections.title: Grok AI features
sections.body:
Grok packs several capabilities beyond standard chat. Here's what each one does and when to reach for it.

### DeepSearch

DeepSearch is xAI's research agent, introduced alongside Grok-3 in February 2025. When you activate it, Grok breaks your question into targeted sub-queries, searches both X and the open web, then synthesizes findings into a report with citations.

The process is transparent. A visible **reasoning trace** shows each sub-query as it runs, and a progress bar tracks completion. Grok also cross-references **X Community Notes** — the platform's crowd-sourced fact-checking layer — which adds a verification step you won't find in competing search tools.

DeepSearch works like a research assistant that reads social media discourse and traditional sources in the same breath. If you regularly need to [research topics using AI prompts](/ai-resources/ai-prompts/ai-for-research), DeepSearch is one of the strongest native tools available. It's available on Premium+ and SuperGrok tiers.

### Think mode

Think mode activates **chain-of-thought reasoning** — the model breaks a problem into explicit steps before answering. It uses extended reasoning for more thorough analysis, and you toggle it with the **Think** button in the interface.

The performance jump matters. In generalist mode, Grok-3 scores around 52 on math benchmarks. With Think mode engaged, that number jumps to 93–96. For coding problems, math proofs, or science questions where you need the model to show its work, Think mode is the feature to reach for.

### Image and video generation (Aurora)

Aurora is xAI's in-house image model, replacing the third-party FLUX system in December 2024. It handles **photorealistic rendering, text and logo rendering, style transfer**, and editing of user-provided images.

The bigger leap arrived in February 2026 with **Grok Imagine 1.0**: 10-second 720p video generation with synchronized audio. The scale is striking — xAI reported 1.245 billion videos generated in the 30 days before February 2026.

A few caveats: Aurora can produce anatomical distortions in complex scenes. xAI also restricts image generation on the X platform to paid tiers following content policy changes in January 2026. Free users can still generate images through the standalone Grok app and grok.com.

### Voice mode and companions

Grok supports natural voice conversations with real-time web search built in. Point your phone camera at something and Grok provides live visual analysis with a spoken response.

SuperGrok subscribers get **Companions** — AI personalities named Ani, Rudi, and Valentine with animated characters, voice and video modes, and a progression system that unlocks new dialogues over time.

### Code generation

xAI offers a dedicated code model, **grok-code-fast-1**, with a 256K context window. On the [ARC-AGI-2 benchmark](https://arcprize.org), Grok-4 scored 15.9% — nearly double the next best commercial model.

Earlier Grok versions had notable coding limitations, but the current generation competes with frontier models. For structured coding tasks, the dedicated code model is the right endpoint.

sections.title: Grok AI pricing and access tiers
sections.body:
Grok offers five pricing tiers, and the differences between them trip people up. Here's the breakdown as of February 2026.

| Tier | Price | What you get with Grok |
|------|-------|----------------------|
| **Free** (grok.com) | $0/month | ~10 messages per two hours. Limited image generation (varies). Grok 3 model only. No DeepSearch or Think. |
| **X Premium** | $8/month | Higher request limits. Generous image generation. Limited DeepSearch and Think. Grok 3 model. 50 daily video renders. |
| **X Premium+** | $40/month | Full Grok 4 access. Generous image generation. Full DeepSearch and Think. 100 daily video renders. Includes ad-free X and blue checkmark. |
| **SuperGrok** | $30/month | Standalone — no X account needed. Full Grok 4 and 4.1 access. 128K token memory. Unlimited Aurora images. Voice Mode. Companions. 100 daily video renders. |
| **SuperGrok Heavy** | $300/month | Grok 4 Heavy preview. 256K token memory. 500 daily video renders. Maximum compute priority. Multi-agent capabilities. |

**The key distinction most people miss:** SuperGrok ($30/month) is a standalone Grok subscription. X Premium+ ($40/month) bundles Grok access with X platform perks (ad-free browsing, blue checkmark). If you only want Grok's AI features without the social media extras, SuperGrok costs less and gives you more Grok-specific features.

**Discount bundles:** X Premium+ subscribers get 50% off SuperGrok. X Premium subscribers get 25% off.

**Pricing note:** xAI changes pricing frequently — they doubled the Premium+ price after the Grok-3 launch in February 2025. Treat these numbers as current as of February 2026 and verify before purchasing.

sections.title: How to start using Grok
sections.body:
Three access paths, depending on what you already have. This Grok tutorial section walks through each one.

### On grok.com (free, no X account)

1. Go to [grok.com](https://grok.com).
2. Sign up with a Google account or email address.
3. Start chatting — the free tier gives you approximately 10 messages per two hours and limited image generation.

To unlock DeepSearch, Think mode, or higher limits, upgrade to SuperGrok directly from the grok.com interface. No X account needed at any point.

### On X (mobile and desktop)

If you already use X, Grok lives in the **sidebar**. Tap or click the Grok icon to open a chat window. Your X subscription tier determines which Grok features you can access — Premium gets Grok 3, Premium+ unlocks Grok 4.

Grok on X is available globally wherever the X platform operates.

### Standalone apps (iOS and Android)

Download the Grok app from the **App Store** or [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.x.grok) (Android 9+ required). Your grok.com account works across all platforms — sign in once and your conversations sync.

sections.title: How Grok compares to other AI tools
sections.body:
We cover full comparisons on dedicated pages. Here's the positioning in brief.

**Where Grok leads:**
- **Real-time X data** — no other chatbot natively searches social media posts alongside web results.
- **Aggressive SuperGrok pricing** — $30/month for full-featured access undercuts most competitors.
- **Video generation** — Aurora's 720p video with audio is a native feature, not a third-party add-on.

**Where Grok trails:**
- **Ecosystem maturity** — ChatGPT's plugin library and Claude's enterprise integrations run deeper.
- **Pricing stability** — xAI has changed tiers and prices multiple times, making long-term planning harder.
- **Track record** — Grok's model lineup is younger than OpenAI's or Anthropic's, with less third-party validation.

For detailed breakdowns, see the [ChatGPT overview](/ai-tools/chatgpt), [Claude overview](/ai-tools/claude), and [Gemini overview](/ai-tools/gemini).

sections.title: Getting the most from Grok
sections.body:
Four ways to get more value from Grok, matched to its specific strengths.

**Use DeepSearch for anything involving current events.** Grok's ability to search X posts and the web simultaneously makes it the strongest tool for questions like "What are developers saying about the new React compiler?" or "What's the latest on EU AI regulation?" The Community Notes cross-referencing adds a fact-checking layer other tools lack.

**Switch to Think mode for technical problems.** The math benchmark jump from 52 to 93–96 is real. For coding challenges, proofs, or multi-step calculations, toggling Think mode on produces meaningfully better answers.

**Leverage X integration for social listening.** If you need to understand public sentiment, track brand mentions, or monitor industry discourse, Grok is the only major AI tool that searches social posts natively. Pair it with DeepSearch for structured reports.

**Try Aurora for quick visual content.** Need a concept image or a 10-second video clip for a presentation? Aurora generates these directly in the chat. It won't replace professional design tools, but it handles quick-turn creative work.

sections.title: Is Grok right for you?
sections.body:
That depends on what you need an AI tool to do.

**Best for researchers and analysts:** If your work involves tracking real-time information — news, market sentiment, public discourse — Grok's X integration and DeepSearch give you a data source no competitor matches. The SuperGrok tier at $30/month is competitively priced for this use case.

**Best for content creators:** Aurora's image and video generation built directly into the chat interface means fewer tool switches. Generate a concept, refine it in conversation, and export — all in one window.

**Best for developers exploring new models:** Grok-4's ARC-AGI-2 score (15.9%, nearly 2x the next best commercial model) and the dedicated grok-code-fast-1 endpoint signal serious investment in code capabilities. The API pricing is competitive, especially with the 50% batch discount.

**Not ideal if you need:** A mature plugin ecosystem, deep enterprise integrations, or a provider with a stable pricing history. ChatGPT and Claude have years of head start on these fronts.

The free tier at grok.com lets you test the basics without commitment. If the X data integration or Aurora features match your workflow, SuperGrok is the tier worth evaluating.
